articles.summary: Medplum v5 has earned Drummond Validated™ – FHIRplace Silver (CRD) status for both provider and payer roles in the Q3 2026 testing cycle. The validation recognizes confirmed interoperability with multiple partners for Coverage Requirements Discovery (CRD) in a structured, production-representative FHIR testing environment.
articles.title: Medplum Earns Drummond Validated FHIRplace Silver Status for CRD
